title: Fraud Augmentation Pipeline
summary: A Dockerized real-time streaming pipeline combining Kafka, PySpark Structured Streaming, and a Streamlit dashboard to augment imbalanced credit-card fraud data for training fraud-detection classifiers. It fits and loads a CTGANSynthesizer from the SDV library (sdv.single_table, sdv.metadata) to generate synthetic minority-class fraud records used to balance the training data.
evidence: augmentation/train_ctgan.py:12-63 uses `from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer` and `synthesizer.fit(fraud_df)`
